title: Steering LLMs Responses Towards Moral Foundations on the Norwegian MFQ-30
abstract: arXiv:2609.21636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work applies human psychometric questionnaires to large language models to elicit moral and value profiles, but it is not clear whether these instruments measure anything stable in models or whether the resulting profiles can be moved toward a target human population. We administer the Norwegian Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) to six open-weight LLMs and compare their foundation profiles to a sample of N = 1,282 Norwegian respondents. We test two steering interventions, prompt-level persona steering and activation-level ActAdd. Half the models engage with the questionnaire under our attention check. The other half default to flat or central-tendency outputs that look near-human on average without tracking item content. A neutral Nordic-respondent persona, written without any distributional information from the human sample, brings the engaging models 44-77% closer to the Norwegian mean in Mahalanobis $d^2$. translated_title: 在挪威版道德基础问卷（MFQ-30）上引导大语言模型的回答趋向道德基础
translated_abstract: 近期研究将人类心理测量问卷应用于大语言模型，以引出其道德与价值观画像，但这些工具在模型中是否测量到了任何稳定的特质，以及由此得到的画像能否被引导至某个目标人类群体，目前尚不清楚。我们将挪威版道德基础问卷（MFQ-30）施测于六个开放权重大语言模型，并将其道德基础画像与1282名挪威受访者的样本进行比较。我们测试了两种引导干预方法：提示层面的人设引导和激活层面的ActAdd。一半的模型在我们的注意力检查下认真作答问卷；另一半模型则默认给出扁平或趋中的输出，这些输出在平均值上看似接近人类，却并未真正追踪题目内容。一个在撰写时未使用任何人类样本分布信息的“中立北欧受访者”人设，使认真作答的模型在马氏距离 $d^2$ 上向挪威受访者均值靠近了44-77%。单对Act（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将挪威版道德基础问卷（MFQ-30）施测于六个开放权重LLM，发现仅使用不含任何人类分布信息的中立北欧受访者人设进行提示引导，即可将认真作答模型的道德基础画像向挪威人类样本均值靠近44-77%。
en_tdlr: By administering the Norwegian MFQ-30 to six open-weight LLMs, this study shows that a neutral Nordic-respondent persona—written without any distributional information from the human sample—steers the moral foundation profiles of engaging models 44-77% closer to the Norwegian respondent mean.
